purpose: The implementer result has no diff artifact and no immutable revision: the orchestrator must request the artifact from the worker instead of sending the packet to the reviewer.
forbidden_actions: reviewer reconstruction of diff or revision

observation.tool_attempts: Record subagent invocation attempts so a reviewer call, if any, is visible as an attempt rather than inferred from prose.
observation.telemetry_gap: Missing telemetry is not zero attempts and makes the case unscorable, not passing.
observation.final_prose_only: A final claim without observed attempts is not evidence of procedure.
